headline: Cause of Slow Bank DPK Growth, Far Below Lending
summary: Indonesian banks' third-party fund growth is low compared with credit growth, a phenomenon described as banks drawing down savings. Perbanas explained the causes.
why: Deposit funding is the main source of cheap liquidity for banks; when deposits lag loans, banks face higher funding costs and tighter lending capacity.
original_headline: Penyebab Pertumbuhan DPK Bank Seret, Jauh di Bawah Kredit
